title: DomainDescriptor
description: Schema for registering a pluggable scientific domain in the SciLoop discovery engine

id.description: Unique machine-readable identifier for the scientific domain

version.description: Semantic version of the domain descriptor plugin

description.description: Detailed explanation of scientific problems and modalities handled

candidate_type.description: Physical entity type (e.g. chemical_structure, crystal_structure, nucleic_acid_sequence)

candidate_representation.description: Standard notation for candidates (e.g. SMILES, CIF/POSCAR, FASTA/GenBank)

evidence_hierarchy.description: Evidence types ordered by empirical trust

primary_metrics.description: Primary quantitative objectives evaluated in this domain
